item.title: Unsuitable diversion route, 26th November
item.description:
With the A435 through Colesbourne, vehicles have started to use the single track road through the village (numbers 29-21 and beyond), up to High Cross near Elkstone and down past The Green Dragon pub as an unofficial diversion route. Vehicles are driving along here at a dangerous speed with no regard to residents of the village. This has been happening since the full closure of the A435.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Colesbourne, Cotswold
